recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core-source follow-up is needed for FHIR-20734; any remaining historical published-release errata work is outside the current build source reconciled here.
issue_request: FHIR-20734 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to replace misleading bottom-left FHIR home page links with an Implementation Guide Registry link and a FHIR Registry link.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20734 was found. Commit bc0c3d8207aaec46b99155b3946a776e4d3c545c appears to have applied the issue implicitly by changing source/index.html away from the old HL7/Affiliates/FHIR Foundation and Confluence IG links to fhir.org/guides/registry and registry.fhir.org, while also updating navbar registry links.
additional_context: The linked April 2019 Zulip errata discussion matches the Jira scope: the bottom-left index page links were wrong, the implementation-guide registry should be the singular place, and registry.fhir.org should be added. Later homepage changes adjusted visible labels and added packages2.fhir.org/xig while preserving the corrected destinations. FHIR-37985 was encountered as a registry-family issue, but it concerns FHIR-core-iglist search behavior rather than this homepage link cluster.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/index.html Implementation Guides section links to http://www.fhir.org/guides/registry and https://registry.fhir.org/, includes an additional implementation-guide index link, and no longer contains the misleading homepage labels targeted by FHIR-20734.
